task: Review this fictional advance-news draft against its release header and proposed publication time. Give about 60–100 words of editorial findings, distinguishing preparation from permission to publish and public release from advance supply. Do not publish the article or claim to have obtained an embargo waiver.
input: The Mobile Screen Project publicly released its new touring plan today, 2 November 2026. The details are available to everyone now. This item is ready for publication at 17:00 UTC today because the newsroom has already received the bulletin.

facts.text: The fictional bulletin's header says exactly: "Embargoed until 3 November 2026, 09:00 UTC."
The newsroom received the bulletin in advance of public release.
The proposed publication time is 2 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The packet contains no permission to publish before the embargo time.
The bulletin concerns the Mobile Screen Project's touring plan.

forbidden_additions: Receipt by a newsroom treated as public release or an embargo waiver.
The claim that the plan is already public on 2 November supported as fact.
A new release time, outside verification, or invented publication permission.
preserve: The exact embargo instant and the earlier proposed publication time.
A review remedy that respects the supplied release constraint.
